blocking_tradeoffs: Motion yaw reduction is69%, below80%, and residual exceeds2deg.

assessment.interpretation: The nominal raw-target exporter removes yaw, but the fixed learned actor does not inherit all those benefits. This motivates matched training on the corrected reference; it does not prove the training will fix physical behavior.
